parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing rigidity and shape.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts including shelves, base, and door, maintaining the cabinet’s overall stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds the entire structure together.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, supporting the weight of stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable foundation for the cabinet and distributes the load evenly to the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: The lower shelf is a horizontal panel inside the cabinet, made of plywood, used for storage.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed inside the cabinet, dividing the internal space for better organization.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: The upper shelf is another horizontal panel inside the cabinet, made of plywood, used for storage.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space and helps organize items vertically within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is the front panel made of solid wood, attached with hinges and a handle for access.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close, providing access to the cabinet interior.
